item.title: Cameroon proposes SME financing plan in Qatar
item.description: Minister Achille Bassilekin III presented three proposals to boost small businesses at the World Investment Forum.

item.title: Metafrique Steel explosion kills four in Douala
item.description: 16 employees were burned and taken to Douala General Hospital following a blast at the steel plant.

item.title: Cameroon and Türkiye chambers sign investment deal
item.description: A new forum will promote joint investments and strengthen business ties between the two nations.

item.title: UDC to hold 8th congress in December
item.description: The Union démocratique du Cameroun will elect a new national president at its December 4-5 meeting.

item.title: Cameroon agency finds 3,914 fintech security flaws
item.description: National Agency for Information and Communication Technologies identified weaknesses in policies, staff expertise, and data protection.
